news.title: DFCITY Suit: Striking-Out Decision Pushed to 26 Jan 2027

recent_en: DFCITY has made several material litigation announcements recently, the latest on 25 Nov 2026; a striking-out decision in one suit has been pushed to 26 Jan 2027. Substantial shareholder Zhang Dandan filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November.
notable_en: The company made several material litigation announcements, the latest dated 25 Nov 2026.
The company released its 2026 Annual Report and scheduled its 17th AGM for 14 Dec 2026.
Substantial shareholder Zhang Dandan filed multiple changes in shareholding between September and November 2026.
risks_en: The company is involved in material litigation and the legal proceedings are ongoing.
The striking-out decision for one suit has been postponed to 26 Jan 2027.
Substantial shareholder Zhang Dandan filed multiple changes in shareholding recently.
